title: 'We're the aquarium'
summary: Bryce Zable tells of 'We're the aquarium', about 1996 at Dark Skies offices, Los Angeles, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: These guys said, "Well, you've heard of the Aviary." And that had been on that TV show, of course. And um they said, "Well, we're the aquarium."

plain: Bryce Zable, a writer who made the 1996 TV series Dark Skies about UFOs, says some visitors came to his Los Angeles offices that year. He says they asked if he had heard of "the Aviary", a group of insiders that had been talked about on a TV show, and then told him, "Well, we're the aquarium," which would mean a second hidden group interested in how Hollywood tells UFO stories.
